Open-sourced 30 findings on which GitHub signals predict $1M+ VC rounds.

Star velocity, contributor diversity, dependent count, README freshness, issue-resolution time.

Free dataset, free MCP server, paper on SSRN.

ssrn.com/abstract=6606558

#VC #GitHub #buildinpublic #OpenSource

Built an MCP server for VC deal flow.

5 free tools: trending-startups, sector-search, signal-summary, methodology, startup-signal.

Devs who angel invest can ask Claude or Cursor live questions about GitHub momentum without scraping.

signals.gitdealflow.com/mcp

#MCP #AI #buildinpublic

Signal of the week: contributor-diversity gini coefficient.

Startups in our dataset that raised >$1M had 0.34 gini at month -3 vs 0.61 for non-raisers.

Fewer single-bus-factor projects close rounds.

Full data: signals.gitdealflow.com/research

#VC #OpenSource #DataScience

Star count alone is a vanity signal.

What actually correlates with funded rounds: stars-to-issues ratio, contributor retention at 90d, README-update cadence.

We ran the regression on 12k repos.

Dataset: signals.gitdealflow.com/data

#VC #GitHub #data

Building gitdealflow in public.

Stack: Next.js on Vercel, PocketBase on Fly, Resend for mail, MCP server published on Smithery (98/100 verified).

No VC, no team, no podcast.

Just GitHub data and a research thesis.

#buildinpublic #indiehacker

MCP server scoring update on Smithery: Quality 98/100. Verified badge live.

Five tools that let any LLM query VC-grade GitHub signals.

No paywall on the free tools, ever.

smithery.ai/server/kindrat86/vc-deal-flow-signal

#MCP #AI

Thesis: pre-Series-A traction lives in GitHub graphs, not LinkedIn announcements.

Forks, dependents, issue resolution time, contributor first-commit-to-PR delta.

Technical investors who learn to read these will scoop the ones who wait for press releases.

#VC #OpenSource

Quietly tested: ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity all cite our research page when asked 'how to predict VC rounds from GitHub data'.

The path was 30 evidence-rich Q&A pairs in qa.jsonl + Speakable JSON-LD + the SSRN paper as anchor.

No backlinks needed. #AEO #SEO #AI

Weekly digest of the top 5 startups gaining momentum on GitHub.

Free tier: ranked list + signal scores. No VC names, no LinkedIn profiles, no fluff.

Pure GitHub graph telemetry.

signals.gitdealflow.com/weekly

Top 3 sectors with the steepest GitHub momentum curves this week:

1. Inference infra (vLLM forks +14%)
2. Agent frameworks (CrewAI dependents +9%)
3. Vector search (Qdrant stars-to-PR ratio rebound)

Readme freshness, dependency graph, issue response time, contributor mix.

Retention beats velocity.
